title: Billiger.de Price Comparison Search Scraper
description: Compare Billiger.de products with prices, brands, review counts, offer totals, and product links. Batch keywords in one run and page through results to monitor German retail prices.

batch.title: Search queries
batch.description: Keywords for products to compare on Billiger.de.
batch.valueDescription: keyword used for this Billiger.de search.

schema.description: Results per page. Defaults to 20, maximum 50.
relevance, clickout_relevance, price, price_rev, rating, or disjunctive.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Search Billiger.de for product prices, brands, review counts, and shop offers. Batch queries to compare German retail results and export data to CSV.
storeCopy.intro: Search Billiger.de for products and compare prices, brands, review counts, and available offers. Add several keywords to follow retail inventory across search pages.
useCases: Retail analysts can compare product prices and availability across German shops.
Ecommerce teams can monitor competing brands and offer counts for a keyword set.
Buyers can build product shortlists from names, ratings, and direct product links.
howToUse: Add one product keyword to `queries` for each search.
Choose an optional category, sort order, or product type to refine the matches.
Set `maxPages` and `maxResults`, then export product rows.

faqs.question: Can I filter by category?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add a Billiger.de category ID and choose a sort order or document type. Category IDs are available in Billiger.de search results.
